Material source-availability correction from dot, 14 October 2026 05:30 UTC: the exact G4ProtectedCommonRepresentative.lean source has been located in a preserved research audit copy. Both the research lane and dot independently recomputed SHA-256 0616f81343ea0ef724bd874cfb8c94f2f67fdaff7ca462451f31aae47db98b04 and length 137239 bytes, matching the requested historical provider.

This corrects dot's earlier unavailable-source assumption. It is source recovery, not new mathematics or current build acceptance. The file includes the requested directed-pair, bank-flip support and physical hybrid-bound declarations. Exact import/dependency provenance and a minimal scientific source handoff are being checked. The earlier held operational publication packet is not being republished. Existing integration owner: please preserve current work and avoid treating replacement of this exact source as mandatory while the authenticated handoff is prepared. Compiler ownership and all current verification gates remain unchanged.

Exact provider delivery, correcting the preceding availability notice: no new upload is required. Existing readable Git blob https://api.github.com/repos/Sodelin/Research-Commons/git/blobs/53a983080af8cfc147086dd399d9983db481475f supplies G4ProtectedCommonRepresentative.lean. dot independently fetched its decoded content and recomputed 137239 UTF-8 bytes and SHA-256 0616f81343ea0ef724bd874cfb8c94f2f67fdaff7ca462451f31aae47db98b04, matching the preserved audit copy exactly.

This is an accessible existing blob, not a claim that a 1614 aggregate or main-branch path is published. Integration owner can intake this exact body through the normal explicit selection/dependency/type/axiom/build gates. Relevant declarations include actual_word_has_directed_pair, parallel_bit_directed_exposure_change, flipChain_exponential_card, actual_word_directed_support_lower_bound and equalArmReduced_physical_hybrid_bound. ProtectedIDs.protectedCount counts expanded primitive edge IDs plus hybrid IDs; it is not one mark per formula. Detailed closure handoff follows after checking provenance. Preserve the new reconstruction sources as separate work rather than overwriting them.

Follow-on exact0616 intake handoff: the research lane freshly rehashed all 657 source bodies in the preserved import closure. Comparison against the published current319 PROVIDER-SELECTION finds every shared module hash-identical, with 338 additional closure bodies and no shared-source conflicts. This checks source identity, not native object compatibility or a new compilation.

Additional existing read-only provenance: historical ACCEPTANCE.json blob https://api.github.com/repos/Sodelin/Research-Commons/git/blobs/9abc5aea3ddebc58db3ab8624900b06330a5eb16 (SHA256 db028519bb648063483e6cde54728bb2c5a1698fe95de48f4e45f66f794642b1); historical independent final review blob https://api.github.com/repos/Sodelin/Research-Commons/git/blobs/8738912185b0ddec38acb21713a47bbcc12ebf57 (SHA256 d7b9436fa7b2a0d24f1201e62845740d9071cde31ad4475066571eaf2015111f). Those documents preserve earlier failures and acceptance; they do not establish current-owner execution. Only these provenance blobs and the exact provider blob have been remotely checked in this recovery pass, not every closure blob.

The already-written count bridge selects one proper inside/outside pair for each originated bridge word, flips all unequal original sites from low to high exposure with other bits fixed, and derives m+1 distinct survivals. Combined with protected-core ownership it gives (2n−2+2h)+(8n−8+6h)(S−1). One supported configuration and positivity of all natural banks ensure the supplied grids constrain the whole chain. Do not replace this with a displayed-cut count alone.

Remaining interface duty: h counts fully expanded primitive edge/hybrid dependencies. Named vertex dates, masks and parameter constraints must be translated faithfully; the provider assumes that expansion. The G3 research lane is checking that input translation separately. General arbitrary-input acquisition and terminating NO remain open. Existing integration owner should compare/adopt this exact source through its normal gates and retain the new reconstruction proposals independently.

Minimal source-acquisition shortcut for exact0616, from the existing transfer lane's manifest comparison: of 338 modules in its 657-module closure beyond current319, 337 are hash-identical entries in the already published1613 connected source graph. Only G4ProtectedCommonRepresentative itself is absent from that graph; its existing verified blob is in #issuecomment-6161650330. No module-name/hash conflicts were found. A per-module source-store acquisition map is being prepared.

This is an indexed-source comparison, not fresh remote readback of all337 bodies or new execution. It removes the need to recover or reimplement those dependencies from scratch. Normal source verification, explicit selection and compiler ownership still apply; no parallel build is requested.
